note: Rots et al. (2023) evaluates the expanded KDM6B cohort and specifically documents feeding difficulties/GERD in 51% of patients, providing direct footing to examine frequency shifts relative to initial discovery cohorts.

evidence.text: In the expanded cohort study of KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder, feeding difficulties or gastroesophageal reflux were reported in 51% of affected individuals.

source.title: The clinical and molecular spectrum of the KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder
